# BakeCalc Club

> Free browser-based baking and cooking calculators: US-convention ingredient conversions, recipe scaling, pan sizes, dough temperature, sourdough hydration, oven temperatures, plus a free FDA-format nutrition label generator and a recipe cost/pricing calculator for home food businesses. No sign-up, no paywall.
